At 35, you aren't just competing; you are redefining your physical peak. Your drive to push your limits beyond the familiar walls of your previous training has led you here, to a discipline where every millisecond of force transfer matters. When you step into the circle at The 2028 Games, you bring more than just muscle—you bring a seasoned, tactical mind sharpened by a lifetime of heavy lifting. This is the stage where your kinetic power finally meets the world's highest standard.

scouting_result.scout_verdict: The sport of bobsleigh and push athletics is defined by the initial, violent explosion of speed—the absolute marriage of mass and momentum. With your 142kg stature, you possess the raw hardware to dominate the push start, accelerating the sled with an intensity that few others can replicate. Your history in strength sports has prepared you for this moment: the ability to convert pure, sustained force into instantaneous, forward velocity. Entering the world of high-performance sled sports at 35 represents the ultimate evolution of your athletic identity. You are no longer just lifting in isolation; you are becoming the engine that drives a team toward glory at The 2032 Games. Your background has imbued you with the discipline to master the technical nuances of launch mechanics, proving that at this stage of your journey, you have the force required to shatter expectations and redefine what it means to be a power athlete on the world stage.
